purpose: Make historical-to-current Canon decisions explicit; semantic similarity alone never promotes a claim.

families.name: Historical Master Values
families.analysis: Adaptação has strong semantic alignment with the current adaptation/essence model. The other five values are not explicitly declared as current Values by PHIL-SRC-0004.

families.name: Historical Twelve Principles
families.analysis: Several historical principles are compatible with adaptation, essence, responsibility and preservation of life, but the current authority does not explicitly confirm the twelve-principle set as a set.

families.name: Historical Integral Method
families.analysis: PHIL-SRC-0004 does not address or supersede the historical Integral Method. Its current status cannot be inferred.

rulingContract.CONFIRM: Promote the specified historical family or item into current Canon with historical provenance retained.
rulingContract.SUPERSEDE: Preserve the historical material but replace its current authority with an explicit new formulation.
rulingContract.LEGACY_ONLY: Preserve as historical Canon/evidence and explicitly exclude from current Canon.
rulingContract.NEEDS_RULING: No current decision has been made; do not promote, discard or rewrite.
